summary.text: Steve Ultrino is a Democratic state representative from Malden who has represented the 33rd Middlesex District since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator by profession, he chairs the Joint Committee on Emergency Preparedness and Management and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ultrino graduated from Malden Catholic High School and earned a B.A. in U.S. history and secondary education and an M.S. in adult and organizational learning from Suffolk University, a C.A.G.S. in educational leadership from Emmanuel College, and an Ed.D. in educational leadership and governance from Nova Southeastern University.

He taught business and economics at Malden Catholic High School, served as school principal and business manager at St. Mary's Parish in Winchester, and was Director of Education for the Middlesex Sheriff's Office.
Ultrino served on the Malden School Committee for eight years before his 2012 election to the Malden City Council from Ward 2.
He took office in the Massachusetts House on January 7, 2015.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Emergency Preparedness and Management.
His legislative biography says he served sixteen years as president of the St. Rocco Society and seven years on the Malden YMCA board, and that he is a member of the Malden Kiwanis.
